story.title: Inside your body, the parts you cannot see
paragraphs_en: "It's raining and I am bored", cried little Mini. "Let's play a game identifying parts of body!" "I know all the body parts! Hands, feet, nose, eyes and tummy!" "Do you know there are parts inside, the ones we cannot see?" "What? Inside the body! Do Tell me." "Just turn the page and sing along with me."
"Inside your head is your bossy little brain Carefully protected from sun and rain" Inside your head is your bossy little brain Carefully protected from sun and rain
"A little below the head, inside your chest You will hear your heart beating without any rest"
"A pair of loyal lungs is present very close to heart They fill up and shrink like balloons as you breathe in and out"
"Now we reach your little tummy and that means food Inside is a little sac called stomach that stores what you chewed"
"Next to you stomach lies a liver so lovable It protects your body and keeps everything functional"
"You move down a little and reach a bean shaped kidney They usually come in pairs and make you go pee"
"There are more parts inside, not even I know them all Look the rain has stopped, so now go play with your ball"
